name: @itunda/design-tokens
description: Single source of truth for itunda's design tokens. tokens.json (2026-07-13) is the real canonical primitive color scale, sourced from Toss's own official TDS docs; generate-tokens.js regenerates the matching marked block in android/core/designsystem's TdsColors.kt and ios/Core/DesignSystem's TdsTheme.swift. tokens.css is web's own semantic/light-dark-reactive layer, manually kept in sync with tokens.json's base values (see its own header comment for why it isn't codegen'd the same way).
